qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Flux?
qh: चुंबकीय फ्लक्स (Magnetic Flux) का 'SI मात्रक' क्या है?
e: Concept: Magnetic flux (chumbakiya pravah) batata hai ki kisi satah se kitni magnetic field lines guzarti hain; iska formula phi = B * A * cos(theta) hai. Iska SI unit 'weber' (Wb) hai, jo tesla * square metre ke barabar hota hai (1 Wb = 1 T m^2). Tesla field (B) ka unit hai, henry inductance ka, coulomb charge ka - sab alag cheezein hain. Exam point: 'Magnetic flux ka SI unit = weber (Wb)'.

qe: What is the 'CGS unit' of Magnetic Flux?
qh: चुंबकीय फ्लक्स की 'CGS इकाई' क्या है?
e: Concept: CGS system me magnetic flux ka unit 'maxwell' (Mx) hota hai - ye purana metric system hai jo ab waigyanik papers me kam use hota hai. Conversion yaad rakho: 1 weber = 10^8 maxwell, isliye maxwell bahut chhota unit hai. Gauss CGS me magnetic field (B) ka unit hai (1 tesla = 10^4 gauss). Exam point: 'CGS flux = maxwell; 1 Wb = 10^8 Mx'.

qe: What is the value of 'Earth's Magnetic Field' approx at the surface?
qh: पृथ्वी की सतह पर 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' का अनुमानित मान क्या है?
e: Concept: Prithvi khud ek bada chumbak hai. Uske surface par magnetic field ki value bahut kam hoti hai - lagbhag 0.3 se 0.6 gauss (ya 30-60 microtesla). Iske muqable ek chhota fridge magnet bhi lagbhag 100 gauss ka field deta hai, isliye Earth ka field bahut kamzor hai. Phir bhi yahi field compass ko ghumata hai aur cosmic radiation se bachata hai. 1 tesla ya 100 tesla wale options engineering magnets ke liye hote hain. Exam point: 'Earth ka magnetic field ~0.3-0.6 gauss (bahut kamzor)'.

qe: Which material is used for the 'Core' of high-frequency transformers?
qh: उच्च आवृत्ति वाले ट्रांसफार्मर के 'कोर' के लिए किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Concept: Transformer ka core aisa material ka hona chahiye jisme magnetise aur demagnetise karna aasan ho aur jisme energy loss kam ho. High-frequency (radio, switching supply) ke liye 'ferrite' (iron oxide + nikel/zinc jaise metals ka ceramic mix) use karte hain kyunki iski electrical resistance bahut zyada hoti hai, isliye eddy currents se hone wala loss (jo frequency badhne par badhta hai) bahut kam ho jata hai. Copper winding ka hota hai, core ka nahi. Exam point: 'High frequency transformer core = ferrite (kam eddy loss)'.

qe: What is the 'Self Inductance' of a coil if a current of 2A produces a flux of 5 Weber?
qh: एक कुंडली का 'स्व-प्रेरकत्व' क्या होगा यदि 2A करंट पर फ्लक्स 5 वेबर है?
e: Concept: Self inductance ka formula L = phi / I hota hai, jahan phi flux hai aur I current. Yahan flux 5 weber aur current 2 ampere diya hai, isliye L = 5 / 2 = 2.5 henry. Iska matlab hai ki har 1 ampere current ke liye 2.5 weber flux ban raha hai. Formula seedha lagta hai - sirf flux ko current se divide karna hai. Exam point: 'L = flux/current = 5/2 = 2.5 H'.

qe: What happens to the 'Permeability' of a magnetic material when it is heated?
qh: गर्म करने पर पदार्थ की 'पारगम्यता' का क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Permeability batata hai ki koi material magnetic field ko kitni aasani se andar jaane deta hai. Jab material ko garam karte hain, to uske andar ke atoms/magnetic domains ki tharmal (thermal) harkat badh jaati hai, jisse wo aligned domains bikharte hain - isliye material ka magnetise hona mushkil ho jata hai aur permeability ghat jati hai. Bahut zyada garam karne par Curie point ke baad ferromagnetic material paramagnetic ban jata hai. Exam point: 'Garmi badhne par permeability ghatti hai (domains random ho jaate hain)'.

qe: Which 'Rule' gives the direction of magnetic field due to a circular current loop?
qh: वृत्ताकार करंट लूप के कारण चुंबकीय क्षेत्र की दिशा कौन सा 'नियम' देता है?
e: Concept: Circular loop me current behti hai to uske around magnetic field banta hai, jiske kendron ki field loop ke center par perpendicular (aane-jaane wali direction me) hoti hai. Iski direction nikalne ka aasan tarika hai right-hand rule/thumb rule: dayen haath ki ungliyan current ki disha me ghumaayein, phir angutha (thumb) field ki direction batata hai. Lenz/Faraday induced EMF ke niyam hain, Ohm current ke liye. Exam point: 'Circular loop ke field ki direction = right-hand/thumb rule'.

qe: What is a 'Neutral Point' in a magnetic field?
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में 'उदासीन बिंदु' (Neutral Point) क्या है?
o: Point where resultant magnetic field is zero
e: Concept: 'Neutral point' wo bindu hota hai jahan do magnetic fields (jaise Earth ka field aur kisi magnet ka field) ek doosre ko bilkul cancel kar dete hain - matlab wahan net (resultant) magnetic field zero ho jata hai. Aise bindu par compass ki sui kisi khaas disha me tikti nahi, azaad rehti hai. Ye maximum field ka bindu nahi, ulta sabse kam (zero) field ka bindu hota hai. Exam point: 'Neutral point = jahan net magnetic field zero'.

qe: Which device primarily operates on the principle of 'Mutual Induction'?
qh: कौन सा उपकरण 'अन्योन्य प्रेरण' (Mutual Induction) का उपयोग करता है?
e: Concept: Mutual induction ka matlab hai do coils ek doosre ke paas hain - ek coil me current badalne par uske flux me badlav hota hai, jo doosri coil me voltage (EMF) paida kar deta hai. Transformer isi principle par chalta hai: primary coil ka badalta current secondary me voltage banata hai. Battery to DC deti hai, motor me force lagta hai, bulb me heat-light banti hai - unme mutual induction mukhya nahi. Exam point: 'Transformer = mutual induction par kaam karta hai'.

qe: The 'Magnetic Field' at a far point on the axis of a circular current loop is proportional to:
qh: वृत्ताकार कुंडली के अक्ष पर किसी दूर स्थित बिंदु पर 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' किसके समानुपाती होता है?
e: Concept: Circular current loop ke kendra se door (aane wale axis par) magnetic field ka formula B = mu_0 * 2*pi*N*I*R^2 / (2*(R^2+x^2)^{3/2}) jaisa hota hai. Jab doori x loop ke radius se bahut badi ho (far point), to x^3 hi sabse bada factor ban jata hai - isliye field lagbhag 1/r^3 ke anupat ghatta hai (kyunki body ka effect dipole jaisa ho jata hai). Isi kaaran door jaane par loop ka field bahut tezi se kam ho jata hai. Exam point: 'Far point par loop ka field ~1/r^3 (dipole behaviour)'.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Susceptibility' (chi) for 'Superconductors'?
qh: 'अतिचालकों' (Superconductors) के लिए 'चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति' क्या है?
e: Concept: Magnetic susceptibility (chi) batati hai ki material field me kitna magnetise hota hai. Superconductor ek aisA padaarth hai jisme resistance zero ho jaati hai aur wo magnetic field ko apne andar se poora bahar dhakel deta hai (Meissner effect) - ise perfect diamagnet kehte hain. Isliye uski susceptibility theek -1 hoti hai (poora repulsion). Ferromagnet ki chi bahut badi positive hoti hai, paramagnet ki chhoti positive, aur vacuum ki 0. Exam point: 'Superconductor: chi = -1 (perfect diamagnet, Meissner effect)'.

qe: Which instrument uses a suspended magnet to measure the horizontal component of Earth's field?
qh: पृथ्वी के क्षेत्र को मापने के लिए कौन सा उपकरण 'लटके हुए चुंबक' का उपयोग करता है?
e: Concept: 'Vibration magnetometer' me ek chhota magnet (bar magnet) kisi taar se latka kar apni swabhavik disha me dolaai (vibration) karta hai. Uske vibration ke aavartkaal (time period) se Earth ke magnetic field ka horizontal component (B_H) nikala jata hai - formula T = 2*pi*sqrt(I/(m*B_H)). Galvanometer current naapta hai, ammeter bhi, aur dip circle dip angle naapta hai. Exam point: 'Horizontal component naapne ka yantra = vibration magnetometer'.

qe: The total 'Magnetic Induction' (B) is related to 'H' and 'I' by which relation?
qh: 'B', 'H' और 'I' में क्या संबंध है?
e: Concept: Magnetic induction (B) kisi bindu par asli field hai jo material ke andar banta hai; H applied magnetic field (bahari field strength) hai aur I (ya M) material ki magnetisation hai (kitna magnetise hua). Unka sambandh B = mu_0 * (H + I) hota hai, jahan mu_0 free space ki permeability hai. Isi kaaran jab material magnetise hota hai (I bada), to andar ka net field B bhi badh jata hai. Minus ya divide wale options dimensional galtiyan hain. Exam point: 'B = mu_0 (H + I)'.

qe: What is the unit Weber in terms of Volt and Second?
qh: वोल्ट-सेकंड के संदर्भ में 'फ्लक्स' की इकाई वेबर क्या है?
e: Concept: Faraday ke niyam se induced EMF = -d(phi)/dt, yaani flux ke ek second me hone wale badlav ka matlab voltage. Isliye 1 weber flux ka 1 second me badlav 1 volt ka EMF banata hai - iska matlab 1 weber = 1 volt x 1 second (V-s). V/s ya s/V wale options dimensional galtiyan hain kyunki wo flux ke nahi, kisi aur cheez ke units hain. Exam point: '1 Wb = 1 V-s (Faraday ke niyam se)'.

qe: How does the 'Coercivity' of 'Steel' compare to that of 'Soft Iron'?
qh: 'नरम लोहे' की तुलना में 'स्टील' की 'निग्राहिता' क्या है?
e: Concept: Coercivity batati hai ki material ka magnetism hatane ke liye kitna ulta field (H) lagana padta hai - yaani magnet ko demagnetise karna kitna mushkil hai. 'Steel' (carbon wala iron) ki coercivity bahut zyada hoti hai, isi liye wo permanent magnet banane ke liye behtar hai (magnetism tikta hai). 'Soft iron' ki coercivity bahut kam hoti hai, isliye wo electromagnet/transformer core ke liye accha hai (aasani se magnetise-demagnetise ho jata hai). Exam point: 'Steel ki coercivity soft iron se bahut zyada (permanent magnet ke liye steel)'.

qe: Which class of substances shows magnetic properties primarily due to paired electrons cancelling each other's spin?
qh: 'युग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉनों' के कारण कौन सा 'पदार्थ' चुंबकीय गुण दिखाता है?
e: Concept: Magnetic material ka behaviour uske electrons ke spin (ghoomne) se tay hota hai. Diamagnetic material me saare electron pairs aise hote hain jinke spins ulti dirham me hote hain aur ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain - isliye material ke andar net magnetic moment bacha hi nahi. Isi kaaran diamagnetic materials (paani, bismuth, soona) bahari field se halka-sa repelled hote hain. Paramagnetic me kuch unpaired electrons hote hain; ferromagnetic me bade aligned domains. Exam point: 'Pair electrons ka spin cancel = diamagnetic'.

qe: What is the 'Angle of Declination' used for in navigation?
qh: नेविगेशन में 'दिकपात कोण' का उपयोग किसलिए होता है?
o: Correcting compass to find True Geographic North
e: Concept: Magnetic declination wo kon hai jo magnetic north (compass ki sui) aur true geographic north ke beech hota hai. Ye har jagah alag hota hai aur samay ke saath badalta bhi hai, isliye navigation (jaise jahaz, vimaan, survey) me is value ko map ke saath jodkar (correct karke) asli uttar dhoondha jata hai. Dip angle (jahan sui jhukti hai) aur field strength alag cheezein hain. Exam point: 'Declination = magnetic north aur true north ke beech ka angle (compass correction)'.

qe: What happens when a ferromagnetic substance is heated beyond its 'Curie Point'?
qh: यदि चुंबक को उसके 'क्यूरी बिंदु' से आगे गर्म किया जाए तो क्या होगा?
e: Concept: Ferromagnetic material (lohe, nikal, cobalt) me magnetik domains hote hain jo ek hi disha me aligned hote hain aur bahut strong magnetism dete hain. Jab material ko uske Curie point (loha ke liye lagbhag 770 degree C) se zyada garam karte hain to thermal energy domains ko random kar deti hai - aligned dhancha toot jata hai aur material se ferromagnetism chala jata hai. Uske baad material sirf paramagnetic bacha rehta hai (kamzor attraction, field ke saath align hone ki koshish). Exam point: 'Curie point ke baad ferromagnet -> paramagnetic'.

qe: On which physical property is 'Magnetic Shielding' based?
qh: 'चुंबकीय परिरक्षण' किस पर आधारित है?
e: Concept: Magnetic shielding ka matlab hai kisi cheez ko bahari magnetic field se bachana. Iske liye us cheez ko aise material se lapet/ghereys dete hain jiski permeability bahut zyada ho (jaise mu-metal, soft iron) - field ki lines high-permeability material ke andar se guzar jati hain aur andar wali cheez tak nahi pahunchti (jaise paani ko nali se mod dena). Isliye MRI room, sensitive instruments aur watches ke andar yahi technique use hoti hai. Reflection ya charge absorption iska kaaran nahi. Exam point: 'Magnetic shielding = high permeability enclosure'.

qe: If a dip circle needle points vertically at 90 degrees, where is the apparatus located?
qh: 'नति वृत्त' चुंबकीय मध्याह्न में सेट है और सुई 90° दिखाती है। यह कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Concept: Dip circle (jhookne wali sui) batati hai ki Earth ka field kitna neeche ki taraf hai. Magnetic equator par field bilkul horizontal hota hai, isliye sui 0 degree par rehti hai. Magnetic pole par field poori tarah vertical (neeche ki taraf) hota hai, isliye sui 90 degree par khadi ho jati hai (vertical point down). Isliye '90 degree par vertical' ka matlab hai hum magnetic pole par hain. Exam point: 'Dip 90 degree = Magnetic pole; dip 0 degree = Magnetic equator'.

qe: What is the 'Intensity of Magnetization' (I or M) for a perfect vacuum?
qh: निर्वात के लिए 'चुंबकन की तीव्रता' क्या है?
e: Concept: Intensity of magnetization (M ya I) batati hai ki kisi material ke ek unit volume me kitna magnetic moment paida hua. Vacuum (khaali jagah) me koi atom/domain hi nahi hote, isliye wahan magnetise hone wala koi padarth nahi hai - M = zero. Hawa bhi lagbhag zero deti hai. 1 ya -1 wale values kisi khaas material ke liye hoti hain (superconductor -1), par vacuum ke liye 0 hai. Exam point: 'Vacuum me intensity of magnetization M = 0'.

qe: What is the defining ratio for 'Magnetic Permeability' (mu)?
qh: 'चुंबकीय पारगम्यता' किसका अनुपात है?
e: Concept: Magnetic permeability (mu) batati hai ki koi material bahari magnetic field (H) ke badle apne andar kitna net field (B) banta hai. Iski definition hai mu = B / H (in units, mu = B/H with B the magnetic induction). Isse pata chalta hai ki material field ko kitna strong karta hai: vacuum ke liye mu = mu_0 (4*pi*10^-7), soft iron ke liye mu_0 se kai guna zyada. B*H ya H/B wale options definition se mel nahi khte. Exam point: 'Permeability mu = B / H'.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Susceptibility' (chi) of a Diamagnetic substance?
qh: एक प्रति-चुंबकीय पदार्थ की 'चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति' (chi) क्या होती है?
e: Concept: Diamagnetic materials (paani, bismuth, taamba-tajja soona, organic compounds) bahari magnetic field se halke se PRATIKOOL (repel) hote hain. Iska kaaran ye hai ki field ke andar unme ulti (opposite) magnetization paida ho jati hai, isliye susceptibility (chi) ki value chhoti aur NEGATIVE (-) hoti hai - jaise paani ki lagbhag -9 x 10^-6. Paramagnetic materials me chi chhoti positive hoti hai, ferromagnetic me bahut badi positive. Exam point: 'Diamagnetic ki susceptibility = chhoti, negative'.

qe: Which of the following substances is weakly repelled by a strong magnetic field?
qh: कौन सा पदार्थ एक शक्तिशाली चुंबकीय क्षेत्र द्वारा थोड़ा प्रतिकर्षित होता है?
e: Concept: Diamagnetic materials (jaise paani, bismuth, soona) magnetic field se halke se PRATIKOOL (repel) hote hain - chahe bahut strong field ho, repulsion bahut kamzor hi hota hai. Iron aur nikal ferromagnetic hain (bahut tez attracted), aluminium paramagnetic hai (halka attracted, par repel nahi). Isliye diye gaye options me sirf 'paani' hi diamagnetic hai aur field se repelled hoga. Exam point: 'Weakly repelled by magnet = diamagnetic (udaharan: paani, bismuth)'.

qe: What is the mathematical relation between 'Relative Permeability' (mu_r) and Susceptibility (chi)?
qh: सापेक्ष पारगम्यता (mu_r) और प्रवृत्ति (chi) के बीच क्या संबंध है?
e: Concept: Relative permeability (mu_r) batati hai ki material ki permeability vacuum se kitni guna zyada hai, aur susceptibility (chi) batati hai ki material kitna magnetise hota hai. Dono me seedha sambandh hai: mu_r = 1 + chi. Kyun? Kyunki net field = applied field + material ke magnetisation ka hissa. Isliye soft iron ke liye chi = 999 ho to mu_r = 1000; diamagnetic me chi negative hone ke kaaran mu_r 1 se kam ho jaata hai. Exam point: 'mu_r = 1 + chi (yaad rakhein ye formula)'.

qe: Which physical phenomenon is utilized in the 'Magnetic Braking' systems of modern high-speed trains?
qh: उच्च गति वाली ट्रेनों की 'चुंबकीय ब्रेकिंग' में किस घटना का उपयोग होता है?
e: Concept: Magnetic braking me train ke chassis par strong magnets aur patari ke paas metal (disk/rail) hote hain. Jab train chalti hai to badalta magnetic flux uss metal me chakradaar (circular) currents paida karta hai - inhe 'eddy currents' kehte hain. Lenz ke niyam ke kaaran ye currents aisi force lagate hain jo motion ka virodh karti hai, isliye train bina ghisaav (friction) bina tez ho jaati hai. Ye system ghisay ke brake se kam wear karta hai. Exam point: 'Magnetic braking = eddy currents (Lenz ka virodh)'.

qe: Why does a transformer require an alternating current (AC) to operate rather than direct current (DC)?
qh: ट्रांसफार्मर केवल AC के साथ ही क्यों काम करता है, DC के साथ क्यों नहीं?
o: AC decreases the coil resistance to absolute zero
DC voltage cannot flow through copper wire
DC destroys the winding insulation immediately
Transformers require continuously changing magnetic flux to induce voltage
e: Concept: Transformer ka kaam mutual induction par chalta hai - primary me badalta hua current secondary me voltage paida karta hai. Iske liye magnetic flux ka LAGATAR BADALNA zaroori hai. AC (alternating current) har second apni disha/maatra badalta hai, isliye flux bhi badalta rehta hai aur EMF paida hota hai. DC (direct current) constant rehta hai, flux constant, isliye induction zero - transformer kaam nahi karta (aur winding jal sakti hai). Exam point: 'Transformer ko AC chahiye kyunki flux ka badalna zaroori hai'.

qe: Which fundamental law determines the 'Polarity' and direction of an induced EMF?
qh: प्रेरित EMF की 'ध्रुवता' (Polarity) जानने के लिए किस नियम का उपयोग होता है?
e: Concept: Jab coil me flux ka badlav kisi bhi kaaran se hota hai, to usme EMF paida hota hai - aur us EMF ki POLARITY/direction nikalne ke liye Lenz's law use karte hain: induced emf/current hamesha aisa hota hai jo us badlav ka virodh kare. Isse minus sign aata hai (Faraday+Lenz). Coulomb charge ke force ke liye, Biot-Savart field ki magnitude ke liye, Ampere law bhi field ke liye hai - direction/polarity ke liye Lenz hi hai. Exam point: 'Induced EMF ki direction/polarity = Lenz's law'.

qe: What is the CGS unit of 'Magnetic Field Strength' (H)?
qh: CGS में 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र तीव्रता' (H) की इकाई क्या है?
e: Concept: Magnetic field strength (H) ko CGS system me 'oersted' (Oe) me naapa jata hai. Aaj kal SI unit ampere per metre (A/m) zyada use hota hai; conversion: 1 oersted = 79.6 A/m (lagbhag 80). Gauss CGS me B (flux density) ka unit hai, maxwell flux ka, aur tesla SI me B ka. Isliye H ke liye sahi jawab oersted hai. Exam point: 'CGS me H ka unit = oersted (SI: A/m)'.

qe: Which material is used in magnetic recording tapes for data storage?
qh: रिकॉर्डिंग के लिए 'चुंबकीय टेप' में किस पदार्थ का उपयोग होता है?
e: Concept: Purani magnetic recording media (cassette tape, floppy, hard disk) me data store karne ke liye chhoti magnetizable particles ki coating hoti thi. Chromium dioxide (CrO_2) aisa hi padarth hai jiski fine magnetic particles tapes par lagai jaati hain - ye field ke hisaab se magnetise hokar 0/1 (digital data) ko store karta hai. Copper, aluminium non-magnetic hain aur silicon electronics me hota hai, tape ke liye nahi. Exam point: 'Recording tape me = chromium dioxide (CrO_2) jaise ferromagnetic particles'.

qe: What is the angle of dip at the 'Magnetic Equator'?
qh: पृथ्वी की 'चुंबकीय भूमध्य रेखा' पर नति कोण (Angle of Dip) क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Magnetic equator par Earth ka magnetic field bilkul horizontal (kshatij) hota hai - wahan usko neeche khinche wali vertical component hoti hi nahi. Isliye dip circle ki sui wahan 0 degree par leti rehti hai (koi jhukav nahi). Magnetic poles par ulta hota hai - 90 degree vertical. Isliye 'dip = 0' ka seedha matlab 'magnetic equator' hai. Ye ek common exam sawal hai. Exam point: 'Magnetic equator par dip angle = 0 degree'.

qe: What is the primary function of 'Lamination' in a transformer's iron core?
qh: ट्रांसफार्मर कोर में 'लैमिनेशन' का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: To minimize eddy current energy loss
e: Concept: Transformer ke core me jab badalta hua flux hota hai to core khud bhi chhote-chhote circles me currents (eddy currents) paida kar deta hai, jinse heat banti hai - yahi energy loss ka bada kaaran hai. Isko kam karne ke liye core ko patli-patli sheeton (laminations) me kaat kar ek doosre se insulate karke rakha jata hai; har sheet alag hone ke kaaran badi eddy current circuits nahi ban paati. Isliye lamination ka mukhya kaam eddy current loss kam karna hai. Exam point: 'Lamination = eddy current loss kam karne ke liye'.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Permeability (mu)?
qh: चुंबकीय पारगम्यता (mu) की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: Concept: Permeability (mu) ka SI unit nikalne ke liye B = mu * H lagao: B tesla me, H ampere per metre me - isliye mu ka unit tesla-metre/ampere (T m/A) hota hai, jo henry per metre (H/m) ke barabar hai. mu_0 ki value 4*pi*10^-7 T m/A hai. Henry second ya weber/metre jaise units dimensions ke hisaab se match nahi karte. Exam point: 'Permeability ka SI unit = T m/A = henry/metre'.

qe: What is the SI unit of 'Mutual Inductance'?
qh: 'अन्योन्य प्रेरकत्व' (Mutual Inductance) की SI इकाई क्या है?
e: Concept: Mutual inductance batati hai ki ek coil me current ke badalne se doosri coil me kitna EMF paida hota hai. Iska SI unit henry (H) hai - wahi unit self inductance ka bhi hota hai (kyunki dono ka sambandh flux/current se hai). 1 henry = 1 weber/ampere = 1 V-s/A. Ohm resistance ka unit hai, tesla field ka, weber flux ka - sab alag hain. Exam point: 'Mutual inductance ka SI unit = henry (H)'.

qe: Why is the core of a Moving Coil Galvanometer made of Soft Iron?
qh: 'मूविंग कॉइल गैल्वेनोमीटर' का कोर आमतौर पर नरम लोहे का क्यों बना होता है?
o: To stop the pointer by mechanical friction
To make the field radial and strongly concentrated
To make the coil completely non-magnetic
e: Concept: Moving coil galvanometer me coil charon taraf se magnet ke poles ke beech hoti hai. Agar core khaali (hawa) ho to field lines scatter ho jaati hain aur coil ke different positions par field ki value badalti hai - isse reading galat aati hai. Soft iron core dalne se field lines uske andar se guzarti hain aur coil jagah par lagbhag radial (kendriya) aur tez concentrated field milti hai - isliye torque har position par barabar lagta hai aur scale linear ho jata hai. Exam point: 'Soft iron core = radial + strong field banane ke liye'.

qe: What happens to the 'Induced EMF' in a coil if the speed of an approaching magnet is doubled?
qh: यदि कुंडली की ओर बढ़ते चुंबक की गति दोगुनी कर दी जाए, तो 'प्रेरित EMF' का क्या होगा?
e: Concept: Faraday ke niyam se induced EMF = -d(flux)/dt hota hai. Agar magnet ko coil ke paas zyada tez (double speed) se ghumate/laate hain, to flux bhi utni hi tez badalta hai aur induced EMF bhi lagbhag utna hi gunna (proportional) ho jata hai. Isi kaaran cycle dynamo ki roshni tez chalane par badh jaati hai, aur power plant ki turbine ka speed matter karta hai. EMF do guna hone par current bhi badh jata hai. Exam point: 'Chumbak ki speed dugni = induced EMF lagbhag dugna'.

qe: Which material is widely used to make extremely strong 'Permanent Magnets' for headphones and hard drives?
qh: हेडफोन और आधुनिक उपकरणों के लिए 'स्थायी चुंबक' बनाने में किस मजबूत सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Concept: Bahut strong permanent magnet banane ke liye aisa material chahiye jiski retentivity (magnetism pakde rakhne ki kshamta) aur coercivity (demagnetise hona mushkil) dono zyada ho. 'Neodymium' (Nd2Fe14B) mishran aaj ki sabse strong permanent magnet material hai - iska magnetic strength iron/steel se kai guna zyada hota hai, isliye headphones, speakers, hard disk motors aur MRI me use hota hai. Pure copper/aluminium non-magnetic hain aur soft iron temporary magnet ke liye hota hai. Exam point: 'Sabse strong permanent magnet = neodymium (NdFeB)'.

qe: The width of a material's 'Hysteresis Loop' is a direct measure of its:
qh: 'चुंबकीय हिस्टेरेसिस' लूप की चौड़ाई मुख्य रूप से किससे संबंधित है?
e: Concept: Hysteresis loop B (field) aur H (magnetising field) ke beech ka chakkar dikhata hai. Loop ki CHAURAI (width) batati hai ki material ko ek baar magnetise karke demagnetise karne me kitna ulta field lagta hai - yaani coercivity. Jitni wide loop, utna zyada H ko palatna padta hai (permanent magnet ke liye accha), par utni zyada energy loss bhi hoti hai (transformer ke liye bura). Isliye core me narrow loop wala soft iron lagate hain. Exam point: 'Hysteresis loop ki width = coercivity'.

qe: What is the 'Trajectory' of a charged particle entering a uniform magnetic field at an acute angle (theta < 90)?
qh: यदि कोई आवेश 90° से कम कोण पर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में प्रवेश करे, तो उसका 'पथ' क्या होगा?
e: Concept: Koi charged particle agar magnetic field me theek perpendicular (90 degree) se ghusay to wo circle banata hai; agar bilkul parallel (0 degree) ghusay to seedha nikal jata hai. Jab akut angle (0 se 90 ke beech) par ghusay, to speed ke do hisse ban jate hain - ek field ke saath (jitna seedha chalke aage badhega) aur ek field ke perpendicular (jitna ghumayega). Isi do movements ke milne se particle ka path spiral (helical) ban jata hai - jaise spring ki shakal. Exam point: 'Angle par ghusay = helical/spiral path; 90 degree = circle'.

qe: Which component in fluorescent tubelights operates on the principle of 'Self Induction' to strike an arc?
qh: ट्यूबलाइट में कौन सा उपकरण 'स्व-प्रेरण' (Self Induction) के सिद्धांत पर कार्य करता है?
e: Concept: Fluorescent tubelight ko jalane ke liye ek badi voltage chahiye hoti hai jo gas me arc (bijli ki kirnein) shuru kare. 'Choke coil' ek inductor hai jo self induction ka faisla karta hai: jab circuit ka current badalta hai to wo uske badlav ka virodh karke bahut zyada voltage (L di/dt) paida kar deta hai, jo tube me arc start karne ke liye kaafi hoti hai. Arc chalu hone ke baad choke current ko limit me rakhta hai. Isliye choke self induction ka udaharan hai. Exam point: 'Tubelight/choke coil = self induction se high voltage'.

qe: How does the 'Retentivity' of Steel compare to that of Soft Iron?
qh: नरम लोहे की तुलना में स्टील की 'धारणशीलता' (Retentivity) क्या होती है?
e: Concept: 'Retentivity' batati hai ki magnet hatane ke baad material me kitni magnetism bachi rehti hai. Steel (carbon mix wala loha) ki retentivity soft iron se zyada hoti hai - isliye steel ka magnet bana kar rakha jaye to wo apna magnetpan lambe samay tak rakh sakta hai (permanent magnet). Soft iron ki retentivity kam hoti hai, isliye wo electromagnets aur transformer core me aata hai jahan field band karte hi magnetism khatam ho jaana chahiye. Exam point: 'Steel ki retentivity soft iron se zyada (permanent magnet ke liye)'.

qe: What is an 'Aclinic Line' on a geomagnetic map?
qh: 'एक्लिनिक रेखा' (Aclinic Line) किसे जोड़ती है?
o: Points of zero magnetic dip (Magnetic Equator)
Points of equal magnetic horizontal intensity
e: Concept: Earth ka magnetic field ki disha har jagah ek jaisi nahi hoti - kuch jagah poori tarah horizontal hoti hai aur kuch par vertical jhukav hota hai. Is jhukav ko dip kehte hain. 'Aclinic line' wo imaginary line hai jahan dip angle bilkul ZERO rehta hai - yaani magnetic equator wali line. Iske ulta 'isoclinic' wahan join karti hai jahan dip ki value same ho. Declination (north se angle) alag line se dikhai jaati hai (isogonic/agonic). Exam point: 'Aclinic line = zero dip (magnetic equator)'.

qe: What is an 'Isogonic Line' on a magnetic map?
qh: 'आइसोगोनिक रेखा' (Isogonic Line) क्या दर्शाती है?
o: Line joining places of equal magnetic dip
Line joining places of equal magnetic declination
e: Concept: Compass ki sui magnetic north dikhati hai, par asli (geographic) uttar thoda alag hota hai - ye farq har sthan par badalta hai. Is lok me aise saare sthanon ko jodne wali line jo SAMAN declination rakhte hain, unhe 'isogonic lines' kehte hain. Aaj ke maps par isi lines se pata chalta hai ki aapke ilake me compass ko kitna degree adjust karna hai. 'Agonic line' wo hoti hai jahan declination zero ho. Exam point: 'Isogonic line = equal declination wale sthan (magnetic maps par)'.

qe: What is an 'Agonic Line' on a geomagnetic chart?
qh: 'एगोनिक रेखा' (Agonic Line) क्या है?
o: Line joining places of zero magnetic declination
Line where compass points straight down
Line joining places of zero magnetic dip
e: Concept: Declination batati hai ki magnetic north asli (geographic) north se kitna degree door hai. Kuch lines par ye declination bilkul ZERO hoti hai - matlab wahan compass ki sui theek asli uttar hi dikhati hai. Aise sthanon ko jodne wali line ko 'agonic line' (ya zero declination line) kehte hain. Iske alawa isogonic (equal declination) aur isoclinic (equal dip), aclinic (zero dip) lines hoti hain. Exam point: 'Agonic line = jahan declination zero ho'.

qe: What is an 'Isoclinic Line' on a geomagnetic chart?
qh: 'आइसोक्लिनिक रेखा' (Isoclinic Line) क्या है?
o: Line connecting places of equal magnetic declination
Line connecting places of equal magnetic dip
e: Concept: Earth ke magnetic field ka ek hissa horizontal (B_H) hota hai aur ek vertical (B_V). 'Isoclinic' lines wo lines hain jo un saare sthanon ko jodti hain jahan DIP angle (kisi v shukanj ki value) ek jaisa ho - yaani jahan field ka jhukav barabar hai. 'Aclinic' zero dip wali line hai, 'isogonic' equal declination wali, aur 'agonic' zero declination wali. Ye teeno shabd (isogonic, isoclinic, aclinic, agonic) paper me aksar aapas me mix kar diye jate hain. Exam point: 'Isoclinic line = equal magnetic dip wale sthan'.

qe: What happens to the 'Self Inductance' of a long solenoid if a Soft Iron Core is inserted inside it?
qh: यदि परिनालिका में 'नरम लोहे का कोर' डाला जाए, तो उसके 'स्व-प्रेरकत्व' का क्या होगा?
e: Concept: Solenoid ek cylindrical coil hai; uski self inductance L = mu_0 * mu_r * N^2 * A / l hoti hai (yaan formula me mu_r aata hai). Khaali (air) core me mu_r lagbhag 1 hota hai. Jab bade permeability wala soft iron core andar daal dete hain, to mu_r hazaar guna badh jata hai - isliye L (self inductance) kai guna badh jaati hai. Isi kaaran electromagnet aur transformer me iron core dalte hain. Exam point: 'Soft iron core dalne par self inductance bahut badh jati hai (mu_r ke kaaran)'.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Field' at the exact center of a flat circular loop of radius R carrying current I?
qh: R त्रिज्या वाले वृत्ताकार धारावाही लूप के केंद्र पर 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Circular loop ke centre par magnetic field ka formula B = mu_0 * I / (2R) hota hai, jahan I current aur R loop ka radius hai. Dhyan do: radius badhne par field ghatta hai (ulta sambandh). Ye value loop ke centre par maximum hoti hai; kinaare se door jaane par ghat-ti jaati hai. 2*pi*R wala denominator lambi straight wire ke liye hota hai, isliye wo option galat hai. Exam point: 'Loop ke centre par B = mu_0 I / (2R)'.

qe: What is the SI unit of 'Intensity of Magnetization' (M)?
qh: चुंबकन की तीव्रता (M) की SI इकाई क्या है?
e: Concept: Intensity of magnetization (M) batati hai ki kisi padarth ke ek kub-mikta volume me kitna magnetic moment paida hua hai - maglab M = (total magnetic moment) / volume. Magnetic moment ka unit A m^2 hai aur volume ka m^3 - isliye M ka unit ampere per metre (A/m) banta hai. Yahi unit magnetic field strength H ka bhi hota hai. Henry/meter permeability ka unit hai, tesla B ka. Exam point: 'Intensity of magnetization M ka SI unit = A/m'.

qe: The total energy loss per cycle due to 'Magnetic Hysteresis' in a core material is proportional to:
qh: 'हिस्टेरेसिस हानि' मुख्य रूप से किसके समानुपाती होती है?
o: Area of the B-H hysteresis loop
e: Concept: Hysteresis loss wo energy hai jo ek cycle me material ko magnetise-demagnetise karne me heat ke roop me kharch ho jaati hai. Iska sabse bada raaz ye hai ki ye loss B-H loop ke kshetrfal (area) ke barabar hoti hai - jitna bada loop, utni zyada loss. Isi liye transformer aur motor ke core me narrow loop wala soft iron (silicon steel) use karte hain, aur permanent magnet ke liye wide loop wala steel. Exam point: 'Hysteresis loss per cycle = B-H loop ka area'.

qe: What is the value of the 'Permeability of Free Space' (mu_0)?
qh: मुक्त आकाश की चुंबकीय पारगम्यता (mu_0) का सटीक मान क्या है?
e: Concept: mu_0 ko 'permeability of free space' kehte hain - ye vacuum/hawa me magnetic field aur magnetising field ka sambandh batane wala fixed constant hai: mu_0 = 4 * pi * 10^-7 T m/A (lagbhag 1.257 x 10^-6). Ye ek fundamental constant hai jo Ampere's law jaise formulas me aata hai. Diye gaye doosre options doosre constants hain: 1.6*10^-19 electron ka charge, 9*10^9 Coulomb's constant, 8.85*10^-12 permittivity of free space (epsilon_0). Exam point: 'mu_0 = 4 pi x 10^-7 T m/A'.

qe: What is the full form of 'MRI' in diagnostic medicine?
qh: चिकित्सा विज्ञान में 'MRI' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: Concept: MRI ek medical imaging technique hai jiska poora naam 'Magnetic Resonance Imaging' hai. Isme bahut strong magnetic field aur radio waves se body ke andar ke hydrogen atoms (paani) ki sthiti ki taraf se image banti hai - isliye ye X-ray ki tarah radiation nahi deta aur soft tissues (dimaag, jod) ko bahut saaf dikhata hai. Isi kaaran naam me 'magnetic' aur 'resonance' dono hain. Exam point: 'MRI = Magnetic Resonance Imaging'.

qe: What is the SI unit of 'Magnetic Dipole Moment' (m)?
qh: चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण की SI इकाई क्या है?
e: Concept: Magnetic dipole moment (m) batata hai ki koi chhota magnet/current loop kitna strong hai. Iska SI unit ampere-metre^2 (A m^2) hai; kuch kitabon me ise joule per tesla (J/T) bhi likha jata hai kyunki torque ka formula tau = m * B * sin(theta) se energy/field ka ratio nikalta hai. Tesla/metre ya weber/metre units dimensional roop se galat hain. Exam point: 'Magnetic dipole moment = A m^2 (ya J/T)'.

qe: How does the 'Self Inductance' of a circular coil vary with its number of turns (N)?
qh: कुंडली का 'स्व-प्रेरकत्व' फेरों की संख्या (N) के साथ कैसे बदलता है?
e: Concept: Kisi coil ki self inductance L = mu_0 * mu_r * N^2 * A / l hoti hai - formula me turns (N) ka SQUARE aata hai, kyunki (1) zyada turns ka matlab zyada flux har turn me, aur (2) wahi flux saare turns me link hota hai, dono effect multiply ho jate hain. Isliye turns dugna karne par inductance lagbhag 4 guna badh jati hai. Isi wajah se chhoti coil par hazaaron turns lagakar zyada inductance milti hai. Exam point: 'Self inductance ~ N^2 (turns ka square)'.

qe: Lenz's Law of electromagnetic induction is a direct mathematical consequence of which universal law?
qh: 'लेंज का नियम' किस मौलिक संरक्षण नियम पर आधारित है?
e: Concept: Lenz ka niyam kehta hai ki induced current hamesha us badlav ka virodh karta hai jo use paida karta hai. Iske bina energy ka sanrakshan (conservation) toot jata - jaise agar induced current madad karta, to bina energy diye hi current badhta chala jata (perpetual motion jaisa). Isi kaaran Lenz ka niyam bhi asal me 'energy conservation' ka hi ek roop hai. Angular/linear momentum aur charge conservation alag niyam hain. Exam point: 'Lenz ka niyam = energy conservation ka parinaam'.

qe: Which rule is deployed to determine the 'Direction of Magnetic Force' on a moving positive charge in a field?
qh: गतिमान धनावेश पर 'चुंबकीय बल की दिशा' जानने के लिए किस नियम का उपयोग होता है?
e: Concept: Magnetic field me chalte hue charge par lagne wali force F = q (v x B) hoti hai. Iski disha dhoondhne ke liye Fleming's Left-hand rule use karte hain: left haath ki tarjani (forefinger) field ki disha me, madhyama (middle finger) current (ya positive charge ki chal) ki disha me rakhein - to angutha (thumb) force ki disha batata hai. Fleming's right-hand rule induced current ke liye hota hai (generator). Exam point: 'Charge par magnetic force = Fleming's left-hand rule (motor)'.

qe: How does the total intensity of Earth's magnetic field change as one travels from the Equator to the Poles?
qh: भूमध्य रेखा से ध्रुवों की ओर जाने पर पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र की कुल तीव्रता पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
e: Concept: Earth ka total magnetic field equator par sabse kam (lagbhag 0.3 gauss) hota hai aur poles ke qareeb sabse zyada (lagbhag 0.6-0.7 gauss). Isliye safar karte waqt equator se poles ki taraf jaane par field ki tivrata dheere-dheere BADHTI hai. Iski wajah ye hai ki field lines poles par ek jagah par sikud (converge) jati hain, jisse flux density badh jati hai. Exam point: 'Equator se pole jaane par Earth ka field badhta hai'.

qe: Which device uses 'Eddy Currents' to produce electromagnetic damping in measurement meters?
qh: मापक मीटरों में सुई को तेजी से स्थिर करने (Damping) के लिए कौन सा उपकरण भंवर धाराओं का उपयोग करता है?
e: Concept: Galvanometer me sui tezi se hilne ke baad jaldi ruk jaye (warna reading lene me der lagti hai) - iske liye 'eddy current damping' use hoti hai: coil ke saath ek halki aluminium plate lagi hoti hai jo magnet ke beech ghoomti hai. Plate me badalta flux eddy currents paida karta hai aur Lenz ke niyam se wo ghumav ka virodh karte hain - isse sui hilti nahi aur foran ruk jaati hai (dead-beat). Induction furnace eddy current se heat banata hai, damping ke liye nahi. Exam point: 'Dead-beat galvanometer = eddy current (electromagnetic) damping'.

qe: In a 'Step-up Transformer', which electrical quantity decreases when voltage increases?
qh: एक 'स्टेप-अप ट्रांसफार्मर' में वोल्टेज बढ़ने पर कौन सी राशि घटती है?
e: Concept: Transformer (ideal) me power ka sambandh P = V * I hota hai aur power lagbhag constant rehti hai. Isliye step-up transformer voltage ko badhata hai to current utne hi anupat ghat jata hai (V badha to I ghata). Isi wajah se high-voltage transmission lines me current kam hota hai aur wire me heat loss (I^2 R) bhi kam hoti hai. Frequency aur power factor nahi badalte. Exam point: 'Step-up transformer: voltage upar, current neeche'.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Declination' at a specific location on Earth?
qh: किसी स्थान पर 'चुंबकीय दिकपात' (Magnetic Declination) क्या होता है?
o: Angle of the field relative to horizontal
Angle between the Magnetic Meridian and Geographic Meridian
e: Concept: Prithvi ke do 'north' hain - ek asli (geographic) north pole aur ek magnetic north jahan compass ki sui jhuk kar dikhati hai. Magnetic declination wo angle hai jo magnetic meridian (magnetic north ki taraf dikhne wali line) aur geographic meridian (asli north wali line) ke beech hota hai - yahi angle map me 'declination' ke roop me milta hai. Angle of dip (jhukav) alag cheez hai, aur Curie temperature magnet material se juda concept hai. Exam point: 'Declination = magnetic meridian aur geographic meridian ke beech ka kon'.

qe: What is 'Ampere's Circuital Law' mathematical expression?
qh: 'एम्पीयर के परिपथीय नियम' का समाकलन सूत्र क्या है?
e: Concept: Ampere's circuital law kehta hai ki kisi band (closed) loop ke chaaron taraf magnetic field (B) ka line integral us loop ke andar wale net current (I_enclosed) ke mu_0 guna ke barabar hota hai: closed integral B * dl = mu_0 * I. Isliye ise seedhe-geometric symmetry me field nikalne ke liye use karte hain (jaise solenoid aur toroid me). Doosre options Faraday ka niyam (E * dl) aur Lorentz force ke formulas hain. Exam point: 'oint B dl = mu_0 I (Ampere circuital law)'.

qe: How is a moving coil galvanometer converted into a Voltmeter?
qh: एक गैल्वेनोमीटर को वोल्टमीटर में कैसे बदला जाता है?
o: By removing the soft iron core
By connecting a high resistance multiplier in series
By connecting a low resistance shunt in parallel
By connecting an inductor in parallel
e: Concept: Galvanometer bahut kam current par poora scale deflect karta hai, isliye usse voltmeter banane ke liye uske SAATH (series me) ek badi 'multiplier' resistance jod dete hain. Isse zyada voltage ka bada hissa us resistance par gir jata hai aur galvanometer ke through bahut kam current guzarta hai - isliye wo bade voltages naap sakta hai. Ammeter ke liye ulta hota hai: parallel me kam resistance (shunt) jodte hain. Exam point: 'Voltmeter = galvanometer + high resistance series me'.

qe: How is a moving coil galvanometer converted into an Ammeter?
qh: एक गैल्वेनोमीटर को एमीटर में कैसे बदला जाता है?
o: By cooling the coil to critical temperature
By connecting a low resistance shunt in parallel
By connecting a high resistance in series
e: Concept: Galvanometer sirf milli-ampere jitna kam current naap sakta hai. Isse ammeter banane ke liye uske SAMANTAR (parallel) me ek bahut kam resistance ki 'shunt' tar jod dete hain. Zyada current ka bada hissa shunt se guzar jata hai aur galvanometer ke through bahut kam current jaata hai - isse device bade current bhi safely naap leta hai. Voltmeter ke liye ulta (series me high resistance) lagate hain. Exam point: 'Ammeter = galvanometer + low resistance shunt parallel me'.

qe: What is the 'Hall Effect' primarily utilized for?
qh: 'हॉल प्रभाव' (Hall Effect) का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है?
o: Determining the sign and density of charge carriers in a semiconductor
e: Concept: Hall effect me jab current-carrying conductor/ik-patal ko magnetic field me rakha jata hai, to charge carriers par lagne wali force ke kaaran conductor ke kinaron par chhoti-si voltage (Hall voltage) paida ho jati hai. Us voltage ka sign is baat se tay hota hai ki carriers positive hain ya negative, aur uski value se carrier ki sankhya/ghantav (density) nikalti hai. Isi wajah se Hall effect semiconductor research aur sensor me bahut use hota hai. Heat capacity ya transformer se iska koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: 'Hall effect = charge carriers ka sign aur density pata karna'.

qe: A 'Tangent Galvanometer' operates on which basic magnetic principle?
qh: 'टेंजेंट गैल्वेनोमीटर' किस सिद्धांत पर कार्य करता है?
e: Concept: Tangent galvanometer ek chhoti compass-sui ki madad se current naapta hai. Uske coil ka field (B) aur Earth ka horizontal component (B_H) ek doosre se 90 degree par hote hain, aur sui tritiya (resultant) field ki disha me tikti hai. Isi se 'tangent law' banta hai: B = B_H * tan(theta) - isliye deflection angle (theta) se current ka andaza hota hai. Faraday/Lenz induction aur hysteresis magnetization ke principles hain, tangent law hi is yantra ka aadhaar hai. Exam point: 'Tangent galvanometer = B = B_H tan(theta)  ka niyam'.

qe: The 'Geodynamo Effect' that generates Earth's magnetic field is caused by:
qh: पृथ्वी के चुंबकत्व का 'डायनेमो प्रभाव' किसके कारण उत्पन्न होता है?
o: Static charges trapped in the crust
Convective motion of molten conducting iron in the liquid outer core
e: Concept: Prithvi ka magnetic field hamare planet ke bahar se nahi, balki andar se paida hota hai - core (kendra) me pighla hua loha (iron) hai jo bahut garam hone par bhi pressure ke karad liquid rehta hai. Is liquid iron ki conval (convection) gati aur ghoomti dharti (rotation) mil kar giant electric currents ki tarah kaam karti hai, jo magnetic field paida karte hain - isi ko 'geodynamo' kehte hain. Sooraj ki radiation ya moon ki gravity iska kaaran nahi. Exam point: 'Geodynamo = core ke pighle lohe ki convection + rotation'.

qe: What does Gauss's Law for Magnetism (oint B * dA = 0) physically imply?
qh: चुंबकत्व के लिए गॉस का नियम (oint B * dA = 0) क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Isolated magnetic monopoles do not exist in nature
Magnetic field lines never form closed loops
Magnetic permeability of vacuum is zero
Induced EMF is independent of flux
e: Concept: Gauss's law for magnetism kehta hai ki kisi bhi band satah se nikle wale kul magnetic flux ka jod ZERO hota hai (closed integral B*dA = 0). Iska matlab: jitni field lines kisi box me ghusi, utni hi bahar gayi - yaani kahin field lines shuru ya khatam nahi hoti, wo band loops banati hain. Isi se saabit hota hai ki akele uttar ya akele dakshin dhruv (magnetic monopole) prakruti me nahi milte - har chumbak me dono dhruv hote hain. Exam point: 'Gauss law for magnetism = monopole exist nahi karte'.

qe: What is the angle of dip at a location where Earth's horizontal and vertical components are equal (B_H = B_V)?
qh: उस स्थान पर नति कोण क्या होगा जहाँ पृथ्वी के क्षैतिज और लंबवत घटक बराबर हैं?
e: Concept: Kisi sthan par total Earth field ke do hisse hote hain: horizontal (B_H) aur vertical (B_V), aur dip angle theta aisa hota hai ki tan(theta) = B_V / B_H. Agar dono components barabar ho (B_V = B_H), to tan(theta) = 1, isliye theta = 45 degree. Ye koi bhi aisa sthan hoga jahan field lagbhag 45 degree jhuka hua hai - na pure equator (0 degree) na pure pole (90 degree). Exam point: 'B_V = B_H hone par dip = 45 degree'.

qe: What is 'Bohr Magneton' (mu_B)?
qh: 'बोहर मैग्नेटन' (mu_B) क्या है?
o: Total magnetic charge of a magnetic pole
Maximum flux through a hydrogen atom
Magnetic moment associated with an electron's orbital motion in the first Bohr orbit
e: Concept: Electron apne nucleus ke around ghoomta (orbit karta) hai, aur ghoomta hua charge ek chhota current loop jaisa magnetic moment paida karta hai. Hydrogen jaisa electron pehli Bohr orbit me ho to uske is orbital motion wale moment ki fixed value ko 'Bohr magneton' kehte hain: mu_B = 9.27 x 10^-24 A m^2 (ya J/T). Ye atom ki magnetism naapne ka sabse chhota standard unit hai. Permeability ya flux se iska alag matlab hai. Exam point: 'Bohr magneton = electron ke orbital motion ka magnetic moment (9.27 x 10^-24 J/T)'.

qe: What happens if a bar magnet is cut transversely into two equal halves?
qh: यदि एक छड़ चुंबक को लंबाई के लंबवत दो टुकड़ों में काटा जाए, तो क्या होगा?
o: One piece becomes pure North pole and the other pure South pole
Two complete separate magnets are formed, each with North and South poles
Only the cut ends retain magnetism
e: Concept: Bar magnet ke andar chhote-chhote magnetic domains bankar ek saath aligned hote hain. Jab magnet ko beech se kaat kar do hisse kar dete hain, to har hisse ke andar nayi pole pair banane padti hai - ye physics ka bunyadi niyam hai (magnetic monopole exist nahi karta). Isliye dono tukde poore alag chumbak ban jate hain, har ek me apna North aur South pole. Isi tarah aur tukde karne par bhi har hissa pura chumbak hi rehta hai. Exam point: 'Magnet kaatne par do poore magnets bante hain (N aur S dono)'.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Energy Density' stored in a vacuum region containing magnetic field B?
qh: B चुंबकीय क्षेत्र वाले निर्वात में संचित 'चुंबकीय ऊर्जा घनत्व' क्या है?
e: Concept: Magnetic field me energy store hoti hai - har unit volume me utni energy jitni field ki tivrata ki square se bandhi hoti hai. Energy density ka formula B^2 / (2 * mu_0) hota hai, jahan B field aur mu_0 free space permeability hai. Ye formula capacitor ke liye (1/2 epsilon_0 E^2) ka magnetic judwaan hai. B^2*mu_0 ya B/mu_0 units ke hisaab se match nahi karte. Exam point: 'Magnetic energy density = B^2 / (2 mu_0)'.

qe: What is 'Barkhausen Effect' in ferromagnetic materials?
qh: 'बरखौसेन प्रभाव' (Barkhausen Effect) क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Step-wise discontinuous jumps in magnetization due to domain wall motion
Creation of electric sparks by magnetic fields
e: Concept: Ferromagnetic material me magnetization ek dum seedhi line me nahi badalti - jab bahari field badhaya jata hai to andar ke domains jhatke-jhatke (jumps) me align hote hain. Har jhatke par material ki magnetization me thoda achanak badlaav aata hai. Agar ise ek amplifier+speaker se suno to chhote click/awaz sunai deti hain - isi phenomenon ko 'Barkhausen effect' kehte hain. Isse domain structure samajhne me madad milti hai. Exam point: 'Barkhausen effect = magnetization me step-wise jumps (domain wall motion)'.

qe: What is the full form of 'SQUID' used in ultrasensitive magnetic measurements?
qh: अत्यधिक संवेदनशील चुंबकीय मापन में 'SQUID' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: Concept: SQUID ek bahut hi sensitive magnetic detector hai jo superconductors aur Josephson junctions ki madad se kaam karta hai - ye Earth ke field se lakhon guna chhote magnetic signals tak pakad leta hai. Iska poora naam 'Superconducting Quantum Interference Device' hai. Iska istemal brain waves (MEG), heart (MCG), geology aur material testing me hota hai. Naam me 'superconducting' aur 'quantum interference' hi asli shabd hain - baaki options me galat words hain. Exam point: 'SQUID = Superconducting Quantum Interference Device'.

qe: Why can two magnetic field lines never cross or intersect each other?
qh: दो चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएं कभी भी एक-दूसरे को क्यों नहीं काटती हैं?
o: Because lines are always parallel to the conductor
Because the material core would melt due to short circuit
Because the compass needle would have to point in two different directions at the same point, which is impossible
Because magnetic flux density becomes infinite at intersection
e: Concept: Magnetic field line ek kalpana hai - har bindu par field ki disha batati hai (aur wahan rakha compass usi disha me tikta hai). Agar do lines ek bindu par katein, to us bindu par field ki do alag dishaen ho jayengi - matlab compass ko ek hi samay me do dishaon me dikhana padta, jo asambhav hai. Isliye field lines kabhi cross nahi karti; wo hamesha closed loops me rehti hain (bina magnet ke bahar N se S aur andar S se N). Exam point: 'Field lines kabhi cross nahi karti (ek bindu par ek hi field disha)'.

qe: The directional convention for magnetic field lines states that they run:
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाओं की दिशा के नियम के अनुसार वे कैसे गमन करती हैं?
o: From South to North outside, and North to South inside the magnet
From North to South outside, and South to North inside the magnet
Radially outward from the center in all directions
e: Concept: Chumbak ke bahar field lines uttar (North) se nikal kar dakshin (South) ki taraf jaati hain - yahi bahari convention hai (isliye compass ki sui N ki taraf khinchti hai). Chumbak ke ANDAR (material ke andar) field lines South se North ki taraf chalti hain, jisse poora path ek band loop banta hai. Isi kaaran field lines hamesha closed loops hoti hain aur Gauss's law for magnetism me net flux zero hota hai. Exam point: 'Bahar: N se S; andar: S se N'.

qe: Under what orientation is a magnetic dipole (moment m) in a uniform field B in its most 'Stable Equilibrium'?
qh: एक समान क्षेत्र B में चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव किस स्थिति में सबसे 'स्थिर संतुलन' (Stable Equilibrium) में होता है?
e: Concept: Magnetic dipole (chhota magnet) par uniform field me torque lagta hai: tau = m * B * sin(theta), jahan theta, dipole aur field ke beech ka kon hai. Ye torque dipole ko field ke saath align karne ki koshish karta hai. Isliye jab theta = 0 (yaani dipole field ke samantar) ho, torque ZERO ho jata hai - ye sabse sthir (stable) equilibrium hota hai. theta = 180 degree par torque zero to hota hai par wo unstable equilibrium hai (chhota-sa dhakka lagte hi palat jayega). Exam point: 'Stable equilibrium: theta = 0 (field ke samantar)'.

qe: Why does a bulk sample of paramagnetic material exhibit zero net magnetization in the absence of an external field?
qh: बाहरी क्षेत्र की अनुपस्थिति में अनुचुंबकीय पदार्थ शून्य नेट चुंबकन क्यों दिखाता है?
o: Because random thermal motion randomizes the orientation of individual dipoles
Because the material's permeability is zero at room temperature
Because it possesses no internal atomic magnetic moments
Because paired electrons completely eliminate atomic spin
e: Concept: Paramagnetic material ke har atom me chhote-chhote magnetic moments hote hain, par bahari field na hone par ye moments kisi ek disha me aligned nahi rehte - material ke andar ki heat (thermal) energy unhe hila-ti rehti hai aur unki directions tadka (random) ho jaati hain. Random directions ka net jod zero hota hai, isliye bina field ke net magnetization zero dikhti hai. Field lagane par moments uske saath align hone ki koshish karte hain (weak attraction). Exam point: 'Bina field ke paramagnet zero net magnetization: thermal randomness (random orientation)'.

qe: What happens to the magnetic field pattern of a circular current loop as you move from its perimeter to its absolute center?
qh: वृत्ताकार लूप के किनारे से केंद्र की ओर बढ़ने पर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएं कैसी दिखने लगती हैं?
o: The concentric circular arcs flatten out and appear as parallel straight lines at the center
They form spiral coils around the perimeter
They decay to zero magnitude at the center
e: Concept: Kisi current loop ke field lines centre ke andar ki taraf dekhne ke liye - loop ke bahar wo band (circular) lines ke roop me dikh-ti hain, par loop ke bilkul centre par field ki disha loop ke tekhat (perpendicular) hoti hai. Isi kaaran centre ke aas-paas ke chhote hisse me wo circular lines ek doosre se mil kar seedhi parallel lines ki tarah dikhne lagti hain. Yahi wajah hai ki loop ke centre par field lagbhag straight (aksheeya) ho jata hai. Exam point: 'Loop ke centre par field lines seedhi-parallel dikhti hain'.

qe: What is the magnetic field inside a long, tightly wound current-carrying Solenoid?
qh: धारावाही लंबी परिनालिका (Solenoid) के भीतर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र की प्रकृति क्या होती है?
o: Completely uniform and parallel to the axis
Strongest near the ends and zero in the middle
e: Concept: Solenoid ek lambi coil hai jisme ek hi disha me bahut saare turns hote hain. Uske andar har turn ka field kisi ek disha me jodta jata hai, par bahar ke field lines fail kar kamzor ho jati hain. Isi kaaran solenoid ke ANDAR (madhya me) field lagbhag poori tarah ek-jaisi (uniform) hoti hai aur mukhy aksh (axis) ke samantar hoti hai. Bahar ki taraf field bilkul kam (lagbhag zero) hoti hai. Isi wajah se solenoid ka istemal uniform field banane aur electromagnet me hota hai. Exam point: 'Solenoid ke andar field: uniform + axis ke samantar'.
